summary_en: ¥750M buyback authorized for up to 1,000,000 shares (5.96% of 16.75M shares outstanding ex-treasury). Execution via open-market and ToSTNeT-3 purchases from 1 July 2026 through 15 January 2027. Stated rationale: improved capital efficiency and flexible capital allocation.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Pertaining to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Nippon Felt Company's board resolved on 26 June 2026 to authorize a share buyback programme under Company Law Article 459(1). The company will acquire up to 1,000,000 shares (5.96% of the 16,751,248 shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥750 million. Purchases will be executed via both open-market trades and ToSTNeT-3 off-floor transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 1 July 2026 and 15 January 2027. Management cited the objective of improving capital efficiency and enabling flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. At the time of announcement, the company held 1,590,841 treasury shares.
